start.group_welcome:
Hey {name}! 👋
Main hoon **Miss Cherry 🍒** Aapka smart Group Moderator Bot!
Features dekhne ke liye /help use karo! ✨

general.not_sudo: ❌ Sirf sudo users yeh use kar sakte hain!
general.not_owner: ❌ Sirf owner yeh use kar sakta hai!
general.cant_action_admin: ❌ Admin par yeh action nahi kar sakte!
general.only_creator: ❌ Sirf group creator yeh use kar sakta hai!

admin.cache_updated: ✅ एडमिन कैश रीफ्रेश हो गया! ({count} एडमिन मिले)

bans.tban: ⏱ {name} ko `{time}` ke liye **temp-ban** kar diya gaya.
bans.tmute: ⏱ {name} ko `{time}` ke liye **temp-mute** kar diya gaya.

antiflood.enabled: ✅ Antiflood **{limit}** messages par set kar diya gaya.
antiflood.mode_set: ✅ Flood action **{mode}** set kar diya gaya.
antiflood.triggered_ban: 🚫 {name} ko flood karne par **ban** kar diya gaya!
antiflood.triggered_mute: 🔇 {name} ko flood karne par **mute** kar diya gaya!
antiflood.triggered_kick: 👢 {name} ko flood karne par **kick** kar diya gaya!
antiflood.triggered_tban: ⏱ {name} ko flood karne par **temp-ban** kar diya gaya!
antiflood.triggered_tmute: ⏱ {name} ko flood karne par **temp-mute** kar diya gaya!

antiraid.enabled:
🛡 AntiRaid **{duration}** ke liye **chalu** kar diya gaya!
Sab naye members temp-ban honge.
antiraid.raidtime_set: ✅ Raid duration **{time}** set kar diya gaya.
antiraid.actiontime_set: ✅ Raider ban duration **{time}** set kar diya gaya.
antiraid.auto_set: ✅ Auto AntiRaid: **{joins}** join/minute par chalu hoga.
antiraid.auto_triggered: 🚨 **Raid pakda gaya! AntiRaid automatic chalu ho gaya!**

approval.approve_done:
✅ {name} ko **approve** kar diya gaya!
Locks, blocklists aur antiflood unpar lagoo nahi honge.
approval.unapprove_done: ✅ {name} ko **unapprove** kar diya gaya. Restrictions phir se lagoo honge.
approval.approved_none: 📋 Is chat mein koi approved user nahi hai.
approval.unapprove_all_done: ✅ Sab approved users ko **unapprove** kar diya gaya.

blocklist.added: ✅ `{trigger}` blocklist mein add kar diya gaya.
blocklist.removed: ✅ `{trigger}` blocklist se remove kar diya gaya.
blocklist.cleared: ✅ Sab blocklist triggers **saaf** kar diye gaye!
blocklist.list_empty: 📋 Is chat mein koi blocklist trigger nahi hai.
blocklist.mode_set: ✅ Blocklist mode **{mode}** set kar diya gaya.
blocklist.reason_set: ✅ Default blocklist reason set kar diya gaya: `{reason}`
blocklist.reason_reset: ✅ Default blocklist reason **reset** kar diya gaya.

filters.list_empty: 📋 Is chat mein koi filter nahi hai.

greetings.welcome_reset: ✅ Welcome message default par reset ho gaya.
greetings.goodbye_reset: ✅ Goodbye message default par reset ho gaya.

pin.no_pinned: 📌 Is chat mein koi pinned message nahi hai.
pin.no_reply: ❌ Pin karne ke liye kisi message ko reply karo.

purge.no_reply: ❌ Purge shuru karne ke liye kisi message ko reply karo.
purge.purgefrom_set: ✅ Purge start mark ho gaya! Ab `/purgeto` use karo.

report.not_reply: ❌ Report karne ke liye kisi message ko reply karo.
report.cant_report_admin: ❌ Admin ko report nahi kar sakte.
report.disabled: ℹ️ Is chat mein reports band hain.
report.admin_cant_report: ℹ️ Admins report command use nahi kar sakte.

rules.none: 📜 Is chat ke liye abhi koi rules set nahi hain.
rules.title:
📜 **{chatname} ke Rules:**

{rules}
rules.sent_private: 📩 Rules aapko private mein bhej diye gaye!

warning.removed: ✅ {name} ki aakhri warning hata di gayi.
warning.reset_all: ✅ Is chat ki saari warnings **saaf** kar di gayi!
warning.mode_set: ✅ Warn mode **{mode}** set kar diya gaya.
warning.limit_set: ✅ Warn limit **{limit}** set kar diya gaya.
warning.cant_warn_admin: ❌ Admin ko warn nahi kar sakte!

sudo.removed: ✅ {name} ko sudo users se hata diya gaya.
sudo.already_owner: ℹ️ Yeh user pehle se owner hai!
sudo.list_empty: 📋 Abhi tak koi sudo user add nahi kiya gaya.

getlink.no_chats: 📋 Database mein koi chat nahi mili.
getlink.fail: ❌ Koi bhi chat link fetch nahi ho saka.

chatbot.error: Arrey yaar, kuch gadbad ho gayi 😅

broadcast.no_reply: ❌ Jis message ko broadcast karna hai usse **reply** karo.
broadcast.started: 📡 Broadcasting ho raha hai... Thoda wait karo.
